newsitem.title: USA: AT&T to step down early, eyes candidates - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: AT&T to step down early, eyes candidates - WSJ.

text.p: AT&T Corp Chairman Robert Allen has told directors he plans to step down early, and has come up with a short list of about six candidates for the company's presidency, and the Wall Street Journal reported Monday.
Allen to the board members he plans to tap the finalist for president as his successor to the chairmanship, the article said.

According to the Journal, finalists include Eastman Kodak Chairman George Fisher; Netscape Communications Corp Chairman James Barksdale; W. James McNerney, chief of General Electric Co's lighting business; and Donald Carty, president of AMR Corp.
